_about: Games placed inside the program readers and homes. build-program-reader.py puts a 'Play this' card at the end of the named lesson; build-program-homes.py lists the same games under 'Play' on the home. Keyed by program (the diaspora edition reads its base program's plan). Fertility has no games, by rule, and the Complete Motherhood Journey companion carries none: its four toolkit readers carry theirs. Never place a game beside loss, mental-health, warning-signs or safety content, and keep 3am Group Chat away from the Mind Check-in. 'review' marks health content still waiting for medical review. Plan and reasons: the vault note 09 - Games in Programs.
